captions.ig:
Before you ask for a raise, find out what your job really pays. The data is free.

1. Look up your job and city in BLS pay data (free on CareerOneStop). It shows the 10th to 90th percentile.
2. Save 5 job ads for your role. In states like California, Colorado, New York and Washington, ads must show the pay range.
3. Most private sector workers have the right to discuss pay with coworkers, union or not.
4. Paste it all into Claude and have it build a one page case with your number and 3 results with proof.
5. If they say not now, ask what you need to do and by when. Confirm it by email.

Comment RAISE and we will DM you our free raise guide: where to find real pay data, the Claude prompts to build your case, and what to say when they push back.

Chart numbers are a sample. General info, not legal advice. Sources: CareerOneStop, BLS, ADP, Bradley, Farella Braun, NLRB, Barnes & Thornburg.
